recovery_search.note: The report proves that 8-point HidroWeb-derived sections existed in the earlier HMS workflow, but the original numeric section vertices/native .basin project have not yet been recovered from currently readable connected sources.
latest_findings: The 2026-09-29 HEC-HMS ZIP was inspected from its MIME/ZIP central directory; it contains rainfall/DSS/NetCDF/audit artifacts and no native .basin/.hms geometry project.
Google Drive folder 07_HEC_HMS contains precipitation CSV/NetCDF forcing folders, not the original native HEC-HMS project.
Drive folder 'Perfis Transversais' contains raw profile 86720000_2023_03_30 (Encantado), confirming the ANA/CPRM raw section format.
No Drive filename match was found for 86472000, 86472600, 86500000 or 86510000 in the currently accessible indexed files.

use_policy.manning_values: Use as legacy sensitivity priors only, not as calibrated HEC-RAS roughness.
use_policy.cross_section_claim: Do not assign the old 8-point profile to S01-S09 until the source profile/reach mapping is recovered.
use_policy.value: Strong evidence that measured/HidroWeb geometry exists or existed and should be recovered before new field survey.
